headline: Growth outlook strengthens but weighs on margins

highlights: Logistics 3.8% QoQ growth), marking its strongest sequential growth in three years.
Growth was led by BFS (+4.4% QoQ) and TMT (+9.9% QoQ), while Insurance also returned to sequential growth (+1.8%).
The pipeline reached a record high, up 23% YoY, with 71% AI-led, while shorter-cycle deals (below US$20mn) grew 26% on a TTM basis, supporting near-term revenue conversion.
Driven by strong deal wins and pipeline conversion, management expects H2FY27 momentum to sustain and raises its FY27 revenue growth outlook to low-double-digit.
valuation: Net Income/OCF is targeted at 80%, to be normalised in FY28 • Net Headcount increased by 823 QoQ • TCV wins were steady at USD 466 mn compared to USD 461 mn in Q1.
